text:
\olref{singleton}. By Pairs, $\{a, a\}$ exists, which is $\{a\}$ by
Extensionality.

\olref{binunion}. By Pairs, $\{a, b\}$ exists. Now $a \cup b = \bigcup
\{a, b\}$ exists by Union.

\olref{tuples}. By \olref{singleton}, $\{a\}$ exists. By Pairs, $\{a,
b\}$ exists. Now $\{\{a\}, \{a, b\}\} = \tuple{a, b}$ exists, by Pairs
again.
